issues.explanation: At 10:00 today the capsule was not ready for dispatch: its valve cap was loose and unlocked throughout that same minute, while readiness requires a locked cap.

evidence.excerpt: The courier capsule is ready only when its pressure is four bars and its valve cap is locked.
At 10:00 today the courier capsule pressure is four bars, but its cap remains loose and unlocked throughout that minute.

issues.reasoning: Span fixture-span-v6_carrier-1 supplies the governing readiness rule (four bars AND a locked valve cap). Span fixture-span-v6_carrier-2 states that at 10:00 today the pressure is four bars but the cap stays loose and unlocked throughout that minute, so the locking condition fails at the very time the draft calls the capsule ready. Both texts are anchored to the same stated time, so they cannot coexist: one of the two required conditions was unmet at 10:00.

suggested_revision.before: At 10:00 today the courier capsule was ready for dispatch.
suggested_revision.after: At 10:00 today the courier capsule was not ready for dispatch, because its valve cap remained loose and unlocked.
